{{Dialogue|Dallows|We're planning on blowing up the Trade Federation droid factory.|Nym|You and whose army?|Sage|Yours.|attr=Rhys Dallows, Nym, and Vana Sage|src=<ref name="SF8" />}}
A '''battle of Eos''' was fought between the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] [[Lok Revenants/Legends|forces]], with his recently made allies [[Vana Sage]], [[Rhys Dallows]], and [[Reti]], and forces of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eos]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Although they had various reasons for it, the goal of the allies was to destroy the Trade Federation [[Droid factory (Eos)|droid production facilities]] on Eos and thus prevent an [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]]. Rhys Dallows and Reti were first to engage the Federation by attacking the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] defenses. The two avoided [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and [[Mine/Legends|mines]] to destroy four [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] that sent targeting information to a Planetary Gun, which capable of firing from ground to [[Subspace/Legends|space]]. With the outer defenses down, Vana Sage and Nym flew to the surface and destroyed every building there. Although the allies were too late to stop Naboo's invasion, the group would go on to fight the Trade Federation occupation there.

==Prelude==
While [[Attempted kidnapping of Queen Amidala|protecting]] his [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen]], Rhys Dallows' [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] was disabled and his [[Essara Till/Legends|wingmate]] was shot down.<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] Level 2: "The Royal Escort"</ref> He was later found floating adrift by the scavenger Reti. Reti took him to Vana Sage's base, who happened to be working a job for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] at [[Eos]] at the time. Sage had to flee the job, however, when the Federation tried to kill her. During the [[Skirmish at Eos|fight]], Sage destroyed the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] protecting the Trade Federation's droid factory. She arrived at her base before Rhys and Reti to find Nym was waiting for her there. He took back [[Havoc (starfighter)|his bomber]] and locked up Sage. Reti and Rhys arrived and freed Vana. Sage and Dallows compared stories while making repairs to his [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]]. As they began to talk about taking action, Nym returned with news that the Federation had [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|taken]] [[Nym's Base|his base]]. Rhys told him they were planning to attack the droid factory, and Nym agreed to join them.<ref name="SFUA" />

==The battle==
===Space battle===
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)}}
{{Quote|Eos has a pretty tough defense system, so just getting into the atmosphere is going to be a challenge.|Nym|<ref name="SFUA" />}}
Upon approaching Eos, Dallows and Reti moved to create an opening in the space defenses for Nym and Sage to attack the surface. The Trade Federation opened fire on the incoming craft with a cannon on the planet surface. The Federation also had [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|droid]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[Mine/Legends|mines]] in orbit. Undaunted, Reti and Rhys charged in and destroyed a small [[Trade Federation Freighter|freighter]] convoy that happened to be departing at the time. The two pilots then attacked satellites that were sending targeting data to the surface cannon. While this was occurring, the Trade Federation attempted to send a [[Trade Federation Superfreighter|Superfreighter]] from the planet. Dallows spotted the freighter, however, and destroyed it. They then destroyed the rest of the four satellites, allowing Nym and Sage to reach the surface.<ref name="SF8" />

===Surface battle===
Nym reached the Trade Federation facilities while being covered by Sage. Taking advice from Sage's [[Mod-3|droid]], the two attacked the landing pad first to prevent the assistance of enemy reinforcements. The platform's defensive turrets were destroyed first, followed the destruction of the actual platform. In this manner, the manufacturing plant, power station, and main factory were also demolished. The command center and planetary cannon were also bombed to ruin. Flying away from the devastation, Nym was told by Rhys of [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|trouble on Naboo]].<ref name="SF9" />
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
Although successful in destroying the droid factory, Dallows, Nym, Sage, and Reti were too late to prevent the Trade Federation from invading Naboo. The group would travel to Naboo to help the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|locals]] resist the Trade Federation presence there.<ref name="SF10" />

After losing their facilities at Eos, the Trade Federation moved most of their droid production to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Until [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Geonosis produced droid armies for the Trade Federation before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
This article was created based off two consecutive missions in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. In the first mission, "Taking the Offensive," the player takes the role of Rhys Dallows. For "The Crippling Blow," the mission down on the planet, the player switches to Nym. Destroying the superfreighter and the planetary gun are bonus objectives; this article assumes the player did so.
